issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 asks for the number (count) of swimming pools in Gemeinden with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution query (solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql) selects Schwimmbad.name (a list of names) instead of returning an aggregate count. This contradicts the required output type/shape and would confuse students about whether they should produce an aggregate result (single numeric value) or a list of names.
issues.suggested_fix: Modify the solution query to return an aggregate count as requested by the problem statement. For example, replace SELECT Schwimmbad.name with SELECT COUNT(*) (optionally with an alias, e.g. SELECT COUNT(*) AS anzahl_schwimmbaeder) and keep the existing JOIN/WHERE condition (Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000).
